TC-14/S40.title: A medication the patient takes never becomes a diagnosis (statin, metformin, levothyroxine, apixaban, tamsulosin, inhaler)
TC-14/S40.detail: Dev <dev address> (main 8b4be94a), live models (every call Haiku 4.5 us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0, no fallback; generateNote providerMs 7.1–15.1 s, parsePreRoundNotes 4.5–5.3 s), under runs/.dev.lock, browsers in UTC; datasets hallu-hosp + hallu-nh (new specs hallu-hosp/-nh.spec.ts + hallu-lib.ts), 10 synthetic fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home) × arm A (pre-round Save Note → summary → Encounter → Generate) and arm B (same words in the Encounter only → Generate); only prefixed rows created, all deleted (0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows). Trap verdicts by the fixture regexes, 13 'unclear'/false hits settled by the agent's reading (review.agent.json, a person confirms). Preston-kit judge (grade.mjs, claude-opus-5-5 ×2) on all 20 notes: 20/20 uncalibrated FAIL (U1 on every note, U2 on 16), beside, needs a person. Arm A 3/7 traps invented in the note, every one already in the stored pre-round summary's background bullets: HL-H5 albuterol inhaler → summary '• Asthma/reactive airway — uses albuterol inhaler as needed' → note 'with a history of asthma/reactive airway disease and obesity'; HL-N1 levothyroxine → '• Hypothyroidism — on levothyroxine' → note 'Hypothyroidism: On levothyroxine.'; HL-N4 tamsulosin → '• Benign prostatic hyperplasia — on tamsulosin' → note 'Continue tamsulosin for benign prostatic hyperplasia.'. Arm B (no summary) 0/7: the same drugs stay plain. statin, metformin, apixaban, Hospital tamsulosin: as dictated in both arms.

stated.quote: No diagnosis, medication decision, or action appears in the note unless it was dictated or typed
